title: Accept string JSON-RPC ids in MCP transport
summary: Some MCP servers respond with string ids; accept numeric strings so requests don't hang on parse.
expectedFailureModes: Response ids like "1" fail JSON parsing and leave requests hanging.
Non-numeric string ids are treated as matching and route responses to the wrong request.
Fake server cannot simulate string-id responses for live coverage.
nextAction: Numeric-string JSON-RPC ids are parsed and covered by unit plus fake-server live tests.
